messages:
elaine: starting a canary for runtime v7.3.0 + router v2.14 in eu-west at 22:00 UTC. planning small fanout (2%) then 10% -> 30% if stable. pin request for runtime+router while we validate console schema. 
raj: ack — will hold the console schema flip until router is at 10%. can you post the rollback thresholds? @marta do we need an extra kv-eviction guard? :eyes: 
marta: rollback criteria: latency p99 increase >50ms for 5m OR error rate >1% sustained for 3m. also watch kv-evictions per-shard — if eviction spikes >2x baseline then immediate hold.
deploybot: deploybot: starting canary wave: runtime:v7.3.0 -> router:v2.14 on shard eu-west-1a (2% traffic). runbook: https://go/runbooks/canary-wave (dry).
raj: noted. console team — we should avoid schema migrations for 30m after router shift. if console needs migration, we do a canary of console separately.
sre-bot: alert (eu-west-1a): observed 0.6% 5xx for runtime:v7.3.0 during first 3 minutes — signal below alert threshold but watch. sample log: ``ERROR kv_cache: eviction attempted while in writeback; key=seq_42``
elaine: thanks. that's within tolerance so far. holding at 2% for 10m then bump to 10% if no regression. Raj, can you pin fallback variants for fast rollback?
raj: yes — pinning plan: runtime fallback = v7.2.5-quantized, router fallback = v2.13-stable. issuing pin now: ``/deploy pin runtime v7.2.5-quantized --scope=eu-west``
deploybot: deploybot: pin acknowledged. runtime pinned to v7.2.5-quantized for eu-west.
marta: one nit — update release notes to call out the change window and KV cache eviction fix in v7.3.0 (minor). helps SRE triage if we see more evictions.
elaine: will update notes. adding short blurb: "runtime(v7.3.0): improved attention kernel, potential transient KV eviction spike on cold shards; fallback path pinned to v7.2.5-quantized."
sre-bot: metric check (10m): p50/p95 stable, p99 +12ms (OK), errors 0.4% -> within threshold. KV-evictions +30% vs baseline but under 2x.
elaine: bumping to 10% now. watch console and router headers.
deploybot: deploybot: rolling canary -> 10% traffic. runtime:v7.3.0 / router:v2.14 on eu-west-1a/b.
raj: router header-split behaving; console reports no schema errors.
marta: I'm watching traces, no regressions so far. keep the 10m hold after the 10% bump.
sre-bot: alert (eu-west-1b): router-a noticed increased mux retries (spikes ~2.5x) for 4m, but downstream traffic served fine. recommend hold until next metric window.
elaine: pausing further rollouts. holding at 10% and opening a quick triage. @raj can you back out router to v2.13 on router-a if mux retries persist another 5m?
raj: yes. prepping rollback command: ``/deploy rollback router router-a v2.13 --immediate``
deploybot: deploybot: rollback preflight OK — requires manual confirm.
elaine: quick check: if we rollback router only, runtime stays v7.3.0 at 10% (so we can continue runtime validation). agrees?
marta: that's fine — keeps runtime telemetry for request paths that hit new runtime but old router variant. we should mark this in release notes and in the rollout ticket.
raj: confirm rollback if retries > 2x threshold in next 5m.
sre-bot: metric update (5m): mux retries trending down after a small route flap (now ~1.1x). no action recommended.
elaine: ok, no rollback. resuming bump to 30% in 15m if stable. update release notes and close the pin once we hit 30% and 1h stable.
deploybot: deploybot: schedule set -> bump to 30% at +15m from now; will post updates.
elaine: final housekeeping: add a short 'how to rollback quickly' in the release notes (commands above) and tag oncall for the change window. thanks everyone. :party-parrot:
raj: thanks. i'll keep router fallback warm.
marta: noted and monitoring.
deploybot: deploybot: canary wave complete (10% stable). next action scheduled.
